2324985.resumo: The bill approves the text of an agreement between the MERCOSUR countries for the mutual protection of geographical indications originating in their territories. 2306513.resumo: The bill changes the Brazilian Traffic Code to allow money collected from traffic fines to be used to pay for the licensing process (CNH) of low-income drivers.
2306513.titulo: The bill changes the Brazilian Traffic Code to allow money collected from traffic fines to be used to pay for the licensing process (CNH) of low-income drivers.

2324990.resumo: The bill approves the text of the First Additional Protocol to an economic complementation agreement between the Mercosur countries (Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay) and Colombia. 2324981.titulo: The bill approves the text of the MERCOSUR Trade Facilitation Agreement, signed in Bento Gonçalves on December 5, 2019.

2305152.resumo: The bill approves the text of a Mercosur protocol on public procurement, approved by CMC Decision No. 37/17 and signed in Brasília on December 21, 2017. The official summary (ementa) does not detail the content of the protocol's rules.
2305152.titulo: The bill approves the text of a Mercosur protocol on public procurement, approved by CMC Decision No. 37/17 and signed in Brasília on December 21, 2017.

2355135.titulo: Proposes canceling the effects of passages of two decrees of April 5, 2023 (No. 11.466 and No. 11.467), which regulate the legal framework for basic sanitation.

2351177.resumo: Changes the Bolsa-Atleta law (Law No. 10.891/2004) to guarantee that athletes who are pregnant or have just given birth have their maternity and the rights that protect them respected. The official summary (ementa) does not detail what rules will be created.

2344938.resumo: Amends the law on the Emergency Program for the Resumption of the Events Sector (Perse) and sets PIS/Pasep and Cofins to zero on revenue from regular passenger air transport. 2344938.titulo: Amends the law on the Emergency Program for the Resumption of the Events Sector (Perse) and sets PIS/Pasep and Cofins to zero on revenue from regular passenger air transport.

2337246.titulo: The bill deals with the Municipalities Participation Fund (FPM), a transfer made by the federal government to city governments.

2353462.resumo: The bill approves the text of an agreement between Brazil and Portugal on air services. The agreement was signed in Lisbon on July 2, 2021. The official summary (ementa) does not detail the rules set out in the agreement.

2345468.resumo: Deals with transfer pricing rules in corporate income tax (IRPJ) and the Social Contribution on Net Profit (CSLL). It also changes Laws 9.430/1996, 12.973/2014 and 12.249/2010 and repeals provisions of other laws and of a decree-law.
2345468.titulo: Deals with transfer pricing rules in corporate income tax (IRPJ) and the Social Contribution on Net Profit (CSLL).

2345368.titulo: Changes the law on the protection of native vegetation (Law No. 12.651/2012), to set deadlines and conditions for joining the Environmental Regularization Program (PRA).

2318679.titulo: The bill gives the name "Rodovia Iris Rezende Machado" to the stretch of the BR-153 highway that runs from the city of Anápolis to Aliança do Tocantins.

557678.titulo: The bill defines how the Superior Council of Labor Justice is made up, how it works and what its powers are.

2320213.resumo: Creates a special pension for children and dependents under age who were orphaned because of femicide. The pension applies to families with monthly income per person of up to 1/4 of the minimum wage. The bill amends Law No. 8.742 of 1993.
2320213.titulo: Creates a special pension for children and dependents under age who were orphaned because of femicide.

2324989.titulo: The bill approves the text of an agreement on a cooperation mechanism between the States Parties of Mercosur and the Associated States.

2324977.titulo: Approves the text of a convention between Brazil and Uruguay, signed in Brasília on June 7, 2019.

2313048.titulo: The bill approves the text of an agreement between Brazil and South Africa on audiovisual co-productions, that is, productions made jointly by the two countries.

2348205.titulo: Changes five articles of the Standing Orders of the Chamber of Deputies, the set of internal rules of the House.

2310248.titulo: Approves the text of an agreement between Brazil and the Kingdom of Morocco on cooperation in the area of defense.

2305154.resumo: The bill confirms, in Brazil, the text of an agreement between Brazil and Peru, signed in Lima on December 11, 2009. 2305154.titulo: The bill confirms, in Brazil, the text of an agreement between Brazil and Peru, signed in Lima on December 11, 2009.

2301213.resumo: The bill approves the text of a treaty between Brazil and Romania on mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, that is, cooperation between the two countries in criminal affairs. The treaty was signed in Brasília on June 13, 2017.
2301213.titulo: The bill approves the text of a treaty between Brazil and Romania on mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, that is, cooperation between the two countries in criminal affairs.
